title: Vivekachudamani
author: Sankaracharya (Madhavananda trans)
description: An Advaita Vedanta text traditionally attributed to Shankaracharya, presented in Madhavananda's translation. It explores discrimination between the lasting and the transient, the nature of the self and the pursuit of liberation through knowledge.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/vivekachudamanio00sankrich).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
